# apt packages — Linux dependencies. One per line, '#' comments ignored.
# Install: sudo apt-get install -y $(grep -vE '^\s*#|^\s*$' deps/packages-apt.txt)
# See DEPENDENCIES.md. herdr is NOT here (install from herdr.dev).

jq

glow               # needs Charm apt repo (or snap / go install)
